summary.business_type: Local dermatology, aesthetics and hair-restoration clinic
top_findings: Service cards have no next action
No visible privacy or medical-policy layer
Review proof is present in schema but not visible
quick_wins: Publish verified clinician registration and education
Add service-level CTAs and mobile booking access
Validate live schema and HTTP 404 behavior

findings.title: Single-URL architecture
findings.description: The sitemap contains only the homepage and navigation uses fragments.
findings.recommendation: Create dedicated service and condition pages.

findings.title: Incomplete medical authority proof
findings.description: Registration, education, memberships and reviewer policy are absent.
findings.recommendation: Publish verified credentials and clinician review metadata.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Strong local H1 and meta description

findings.title: Individual search intents lack URLs
findings.description: Six services and many conditions share one homepage.
findings.recommendation: Map one primary intent to each substantive page.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Linked clinic, physician, website, webpage and FAQ graph

findings.title: Schema proof and service entities need refinement
findings.description: Physician identifiers are absent and services have no stable URLs.
findings.recommendation: Add verified identifiers and dedicated service entities/URLs.

findings.title: Third-party font and GTM risk
findings.description: Google Fonts is render-blocking and GTM executes in head.
findings.recommendation: Subset/self-host fonts and audit GTM; measure live CWV.

findings.title: Authority limits citability
findings.description: Third-party corroboration and deep topic URLs are limited.
findings.recommendation: Strengthen verifiable entity proof and dedicated intent pages.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Dimensions, srcset, WebP and lazy loading

findings.title: Service cards are dead ends
findings.description: Cards contain no detail or booking actions.
findings.recommendation: Add linked service journeys and contextual CTAs.

findings.title: Long brochure-like page
findings.description: Mobile render is approximately 13,145 px tall with dense services and FAQs.
findings.recommendation: Improve hierarchy, progressive disclosure and persistent conversion access.
